answer: Sybil resistance comes from a cost gate: each identity must burn a non-refundable fee and post a bond locked to an attested keypair, so running a thousand keys needs a thousand bonds plus fees. Marginal cost of the Nth identity stays flat rather than falling to zero, and a chain mirror records each bond over time, letting challengers slash keys recycled from one wallet. Once expected profit per fake identity drops below honest yield, a reef or yarrow of hollow accounts no longer pays and vote weight stays tied to capital at risk.
